data.one_liner: A fork of Dart's HTTP package with request cancellation support using cancellation tokens.
data.what_it_does: It wraps Dart's official HTTP package to allow ongoing network requests to be cancelled via a CancellationProvider/CancellationToken. It also supports canceling isolate-based JSON parsing when paired with the cancellation_token package.
use_when: You need to cancel pending HTTP requests in a Dart or Flutter application.
You want a drop-in fork of the standard http package with cancellation capabilities.
avoid_when: You are already using Dio or another networking package that natively supports request cancellation.
You do not need request cancellation functionality.
strengths: Maintains the familiar API of Dart's official http package.
Integrates seamlessly with the cancellation_token package for combined network and isolate parsing cancellation.
weaknesses: It is a fork of the standard http package, meaning updates from upstream must be manually merged by the maintainer.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick the official http package if you do not require request cancellation features.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick dio for a full-featured HTTP client that includes built-in request cancellation, interceptors, and global configuration.
